items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: "I just remember you were a really cool guy and we had a lot of fun."

ctx.x: What was the other, after Dry Jack the — I have to insert one thing because this stuck in my head, for our viewers, I was teaching at the school they you had sort of recently graduated from, at Vernon, Verona, Sherrill and you guys were together pre Inner City and you asked me to come over to this house where you were all living I think cause you wanted to learn some, I don’t know what it was, theory.

Rich. My brother Rich. I told you he said to say hi and he said, “Oh man, Monk, that’s great.” But he said, “Do you remember he came over to the house to teach us” Rich said he came over to teach us theory. And I remember you coming over and hanging. I just remember you were a really cool guy and we had a lot of fun. But you know Rich said, “Yeah” though, our history man is pretty cool.
I said, “Play a tune for me you guys.”
